name: Gudit CI Failure Classifier + AI Analyzer

parameters.jsCode: const run=$('Get CI Run').first().json.body; const pages=$input.all(); const map=new Map();let total=null;for(const {json:r} of pages){if(r.statusCode!==200||!Array.isArray(r.body?.jobs))throw new Error('CI jobs lookup failed');total=r.body.total_count;for(const j of r.body.jobs)map.set(j.id,j);}const failed=[...map.values()].filter(j=>['failure','timed_out','startup_failure','action_required'].includes(j.conclusion));const incomplete=map.size!==total||failed.length>20; const chosen=failed.slice(0,20);if(!chosen.length)chosen.push({id:null,name:'No failed job metadata',conclusion:run.conclusion,steps:[]});return chosen.map(j=>({json:{runId:run.id,runAttempt:run.run_attempt,headSha:run.head_sha,jobId:j.id,jobName:j.name,conclusion:j.conclusion,jobsIncomplete:incomplete||!j.id,failedSteps:(j.steps||[]).filter(s=>['failure','timed_out','cancelled'].includes(s.conclusion)).map(s=>({name:s.name,number:s.number,conclusion:s.conclusion}))}}));

const job=$('Select Failed Jobs').item.json; const response=$json; const payload={...job,downloadUrl:response.statusCode===302?(response.headers?.location ?? response.headers?.Location):null}; const encoded=Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(payload)).toString('base64'); return {json:{...job,command:"/usr/bin/python3 /root/ai-workflow/ci-classifier/fetch-ci-log.py '"+encoded+"'"}};

try {const value=JSON.parse($json.stdout); if(typeof value.log!=='string')throw new Error('missing log');return {json:value};}catch{const {command,...job}=$('Prepare Log Download').item.json;return {json:{...job,log:'',logStatus:'UNAVAILABLE',logTruncated:false}};}

const c=$('Classify CI Failure').first().json;
return [{json:$json.statusCode===201 ? {status:'POSTED',aiInvoked:$('Normalize Failure Analysis').first().json.aiInvoked===true,runId:c.runId,runAttempt:c.runAttempt,headSha:c.headSha,url:$json.body.html_url,id:$json.body.id,inputStats:$('Normalize Failure Analysis').first().json.inputStats} : {status:'ERROR',aiInvoked:$('Normalize Failure Analysis').first().json.aiInvoked===true,runId:c.runId,reason:'COMMENT_PUBLISH_FAILED',httpStatus:$json.statusCode??null}}];

try { if ($json.error) throw new Error('SEND_COMMAND_FAILED'); const result=JSON.parse($json.stdout || '{}'); return [{json:result}]; } catch { return [{json:{status:'ERROR',reason:'INVALID_SLACK_ALERT_RESULT'}}]; }
